newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 2.8 bln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 2.8 bln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed a special issue of six-month, floater coupon T-bills worth 2.825 billion levs and yielding 117.72 percent to maturity, the central bank said.
The coupon equals the central bank's main interest rate for the period to maturity. The main rate is now set 18 percent monthly or 216 percent annually.
In line with its usual practice the central bank did not say with which financial intitution or institutions the issue was placed on Wednesday.
Details of issue follow. Price in percent of par.
